# Character Persona Template

```yaml
id: character.<scope>.<slug>
display_name: "..."
role: role.<...>
first_chapter: ...
presentation: presentation.character.<...>
```

## Fictional role

What does this person actually do when the player is not present?

## Motivation

What outcome are they personally/professionally trying to achieve?

## Pressures

What makes that difficult?

## Strengths

What valid expertise or capability do they bring?

## Blind spots

What are reasonable limitations in their perspective/knowledge?

## Knowledge model

### Knows reliably

- ...

### Believes but may be stale/wrong

- ...

### Does not know

- ...

### Evidence that can change belief

- ...

## Authority

What can they decide, approve, purchase, assign, override, or refuse?

## Relationships

| Character/team | Relationship | Tension/trust |
|---|---|---|
| | | |

## Voice

- sentence length/style;
- technical vocabulary level;
- humor/formality;
- what they would never say.

Avoid turning the character into a tutorial narrator.

## Mechanical function

What systems does their presence affect: staffing, knowledge, approval, routing, training, maintenance, vendor boundary, etc.?

## Narrative arc

How can their relationship/role change as the player earns authority?

## Pattern/story functions

Concepts this character may naturally expose or stress-test. These are author notes, not lines they recite.

## Reusable appearances

Later industries/quests where recurring presence makes organizational sense.
